definitions.menu: indices 1 through 7 and no action index 8; uniform decrease index 0 removed
definitions.invalid: any nonfinite draw/option or invalid flag forces no action; no survivor conditioning
definitions.expected_harms: sum over acted instances of 1 minus the share of draws with D < 0
definitions.harms: strict-positive realized D; exact-zero acted ties recorded separately
definitions.bounds: exact one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower and upper conditional on acting
definitions.oracle: minimum realized cost over the same menu as the policy
